# KOKAO

> KOKAO (https://app.kokao.in) is an AI-powered social media content studio. It generates on-brand captions, images and videos, organizes them in a content library, and schedules and auto-publishes posts to connected social accounts — all from one web workspace.

## What KOKAO does

- **AI copywriting**: platform-aware captions and campaign copy tailored to each brand's voice, tone and audience, guided by saved Brand Kits.
- **AI image generation & editing**: high-resolution on-brand visuals, plus a layered image editor for text and logo overlays and AI repair.
- **AI video generation**: multi-scene short videos with storyboard review, narration and music.
- **Auto-publishing**: direct publishing and scheduling to Facebook Pages, Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Threads, including carousels.
- **Content planning**: a central content library, calendar and scheduler for organizing posts across accounts.
- **Ads management**: draft-and-approve campaign management for Meta, Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
- **Analytics**: post performance metrics collected from connected platforms.
- **Team workspaces**: multiple members can collaborate on one brand with role-based access.

## Who it is for

Brands, marketers, agencies and small businesses that want professional, consistent social media content without a full in-house creative team.

## Pricing

Signing up is free at https://app.kokao.in/sign-up. KOKAO offers subscription plans plus prepaid credit/wallet billing for AI generation; current plans and prices are shown inside the app.

## Key pages

- Landing page: https://app.kokao.in/
- Sign up: https://app.kokao.in/sign-up
- Sign in: https://app.kokao.in/sign-in

Everything beyond the landing and auth pages requires an account.
